taxonomy_definitions.REAL_PERCEPTION_VALIDATION: Inference on real asphalt road imagery or video with actual models and sensors.
taxonomy_definitions.DETERMINISTIC_SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_DEMONST: End-to-end multi-domain architectural pipeline execution using deterministic scenario test cases to verify 14-stage integration.
taxonomy_definitions.SIMULATED_OPERATIONAL_WORKFLOW: External municipal interactions (contractor repair claims, subsequent fleet recheck passes) generated to test closed-loop verification logic.

proof_of_closure_lifecycle.stage_1_detect: Real model inference identifies pavement defect
proof_of_closure_lifecycle.stage_2_remember: City Memory clusters sightings within 30m into PersistentIssue
proof_of_closure_lifecycle.stage_4_act: WorkItem and EvidenceChain generated with SLA and DLP contractor lookup
proof_of_closure_lifecycle.stage_6_recheck: FollowUpPass executes over same coordinates [SIMULATED OPERATIONAL WORKFLOW]
proof_of_closure_lifecycle.stage_7_verify: VerificationEngine confirms absence of defect and recovers RoadHealth score
proof_of_closure_lifecycle.honest_qualification: Closed-loop verification logic validated through deterministic follow-up scenarios; real-world pilot validation requires subsequent fleet passes after actual physical repairs.
